description: Country-level fire perimeter datasets (2001–2021) is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Adam L. Mahood et al. Fire activity is changing across many areas of the globe. Understanding how social and ecological systems respond to fire is an important topic for the coming century. But many countries do not have accessible fire history data. Coverage: not stated; published in 2022. Formats: Shapefile, GeoPackage, ZIP. The data are held in University of Colorado Boulder and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
